settings.title: How much does shipping cost?
settings.content: Flat-rate shipping Australia-wide is $9.95. Orders over $79 ship free. And don't sweat it if your goodies arrive separately – you'll only pay one delivery fee per order!

settings.title: Who do you ship parcels through?
settings.content: We'll ship your order through Australia Post. Unfortunately, with some cheaper couriers, you get what you pay for.

settings.title: When will my order be dispatched?
settings.content: Get ready to rock! We typically send out most orders within 1-3 business days from Warwick QLD, and many hit the road within just 48 hours (business days).

settings.title: Will I be notified when my order is shipped?
settings.content: Keep an eye on your inbox or phone! We'll shoot you an email or SMS once your order is on its way, complete with your handy tracking number.

settings.title: How long will it take for me to receive my order?
settings.content:
Sydney, Melbourne & Brisbane Metro | 2-3 business days

Regional NSW, VIC, QLD & ACT | 3-5 business days

Country NSW, VIC, QLD & SA | 3-7 business days

TAS, WA, NT| 7-10 business days

While we're on top of things, unforeseeable delays might pop up, unfortunately out of our hands. Just so you know, orders are shipped from Warwick QLD.

settings.title: Do you ship outside of Australia?
settings.content: As of now, we're only able to deliver to addresses within Australia.

settings.title: Do prices include GST?
settings.content: Rest easy knowing that all prices listed online already include GST.

settings.title: Do you offer your products wholesale?
settings.content: We currently don't offer our products wholesale.
